Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to share an update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for the platform has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally estimated, and that certification step has pushed our schedule back by two weeks. The revised delivery date is now 14 April.

Our team has adjusted internal milestones to reflect this change and will continue development on all other components in parallel while we wait on final certification sign-off. We do not anticipate any further delays from this issue, and we will notify you promptly if anything changes between now and delivery.

Does the new date of 14 April still work with your internal plans, or is there a dependency on your end we should factor in? Please let me know your thoughts, and I'm happy to set up a call this week to walk through the updated schedule in detail.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
